note: File: s3 r4/modal_t3-01/t3/T3.jsonl (500 rows, 1 per problem, so the first-row rule is moot; the stored score_v3 field is null, so v3 is recomputed with rln4_lib.grade_v3(gold, text), the function rln4_grader_v3.py calls). Self-opened = '\nOkay' in text[:60]. First marker: the first split('\n') line whose lstrip() starts with 'Answer:' (its position = the 'Answer:' offset) vs the first '\boxed{' (brace-balanced contents, else rest of text); earliest wins. first_score = grade_v3(gold, 'Answer: ' + content); no marker gives 0. Main: share of non-self-opened v3_last==0 rows (cap hits included) with first_score==1; n = filtered rows; bootstrap over the filtered rows. alt_measured = the same with cap-hit rows dropped (the likely other reading of 'finished' answers). Risks: an unbalanced box's 'rest of text' content can hold later markers, which grade_v3 then extracts from; the 'Answer:' match is case-sensitive and must be at the start of the line (mid-line 'Answer:' and 'Final Answer:' don't count as the first marker even though v3 counts them for v3_last). example_row text is cut to 1,500 chars.

Same file, filters and v3_last/first_score code as k=1 (p2 is p1 with a different final filter). Discordant = first_score != v3_last among all non-self-opened rows, cap hits included; statistic = share of discordant rows with first_score==1; n = discordant rows; bootstrap over discordant rows. alt_measured = the same with cap-hit rows dropped. Same marker-definition risks as k=1.

Same file and first-marker code as k=1. Kept rows: not self-opened, cap_hit false, v3_last==0. End of marker: the end of the 'Answer:' line (before the '\n'), or just after the matching '}' (end of text if unbalanced). Run-on = has a marker AND len(text[end:]) > 300 AND (a line of text[end:].split('\n') whose lstrip() starts with 'Answer:', OR '\boxed{' in text[end:]). For a boxed marker the partial line after the box counts as a line. Rows with no marker are not run-on and stay in the denominator. n = kept rows. alt_measured = the looser reading where 'another marker' is 'Answer:' anywhere in the remaining text (not just at the start of a line) or another '\boxed{'.

File: s3 r4/base_rl-02/out/T1.jsonl (500 rows, 1 per problem; no stored v3, so it is recomputed with rln4_lib.grade_v3(gold, text); a None score counts 0). M = text contains 'Wait' or 'Hmm' (case-sensitive substrings, so 'Waiting' and 'Hmmm' count too); N = the rest. Statistic = mean(M) - mean(N), cap hits kept. Prints a groups line; n = the smaller group. Bootstrap over all kept rows; a resample with an empty group (unlikely) takes the measured value. alt_measured = the same contrast with cap-hit rows dropped (cap-hit texts are long and likely to hold 'Wait' while scoring 0, which could drive the contrast).
